channel.description: The Vergecast is the flagship daily podcast from The Verge about small gadgets, Big Tech, and everything in between. Every Friday, Nilay Patel and David Pierce hang out and make sense of the week’s most important technology news. And Monday through Thursday, David leads a selection of The Verge’s expert staffers in an exploration of how gadgets and software affect our lives – and which ones you should bring into yours.

item.title: Why your favorite creator is building an app
item.description:
Creator life involves using a lot of software. Bad software. Stephen Robles is one of the creators who decided to build something better, for himself and for his community. He tells David how he thinks about his responsibility as a developer, how he makes apps, and how AI is changing the way he builds things for his audience.
Further reading:
Apple teases MacBook Pro event next week
You Can See Everything has the biggest opening weekend for a doc in 20 years
TikTok says ban of Musk documentary account was ‘an error’
Video game ownership bill introduced in Congress

item.title: Apple's HomeView has an app problem
item.description:
Well, it's been a couple of days, and David and Nilay have some more information — and a bunch of new questions — about the Apple HomeView. They also talk about the latest Gemini model, and whether building the best model matters if you can't build the best products around them. They then debate the merits of returning to X, why none of the supposed Twitter replacements worked, the latest in Brendan Carr nonsense, and more.
Further reading:
HomeView doesn’t natively support any video apps yet — not even Apple’s
Apple’s new Find My-compatible remote will also work with your old Apple TV
The AI race is back on
Google finally releases Gemini 4 Argon
Google brings its AI coding platform to its Gemini app on Mac.
Google makes it easier to launch your vibe-coded apps
OpenAI employee arrested for allegedly planting a bug in a conference room
OpenAI claims an ex-employee took its product plans and presented them to Apple
Now that Character.AI is going bankrupt, what happens to all of its users’ data?
Daring Fireball: X Once Again Marks the Spot
Platformer: Does intelligence need a hard cap?
SpaceX announces plan to become a ‘major mobile carrier’
JPMorgan Chase is keeping AI agents out.
Xbox is officially embracing the chaos of AI-powered game ports
Global smartphone sales just hit a 14-year low.
Silicon Valley is falling in line with Trump’s attempt to rename AI
The US government launched a “Super Intelligence” website.
